runs: every hour, after each run of the Senate forecast
what: The governor forecast: reads Wikipedia's overviews and race pages of the coming governor races, takes the national mood from the Senate forecast, reruns the forecast and writes data/governor/<year>/ and docs/api/governor.json, which the Governors tab reads. A run whose readings look wrong stops and leaves the last forecast in place.
how_to_read: ok false: the last run failed, error says why, and the site keeps the last good figures. ok true but today later than overdue_after: the job has stopped running. The workflow link lists every run.
